svg.title: RIG flow accent
svg.desc: RIG flow accent v0 — a single graceful curve that pairs with the rigid mark in compositions. Visual counter to the mark's rigidity: where the mark is the frame, the flow is what moves through it. Used as decorative element in brand surfaces (docs headers, plugin cards, web sections). Color: Steel (subtle) or Oxblood (warm accent). Authored 2026-04-26 in ops_cw.
